title: Load functions: universal and server-only, and the difference that bites

videos.script:
So far the planner has asked for its data after the page appeared. {{load}} A load function asks before. The server can then send a finished page, and the loading message goes away.

Then the data moves somewhere only the server can read it. {{server}} The obvious way to do that fails, and it fails in the browser, not on the server. The fix is one word in a file name.

Then what a server load sends across. {{wire}} You will read it the way the browser does. And you will see the one kind of value that cannot make the trip.

Then the course page gets a load of its own. {{parent}} It finds its course, or it answers four oh four.

And last, the question this lesson is named for. {{where}} Where does each kind of load run, and how often? {{rerun}} One of them runs in two places, and the other runs once. Knowing which is which saves an afternoon.
